title: Jack Horton breaks free with soulful track “Set Me Free”
htmlContent: "Set Me Free" is the first song from his forthcoming EP and serves as a compelling declaration of independence for Jack Horton. It was the first drop in his waterfall style of singles, indicating the opening chapter of what looks set to be one emotional rollercoaster ride of catchy, soulful storytelling and gritty feeling. It's obvious Horton is a born singer-songwriter. His voice is an ideal blend of strength and vulnerability, pulling people in with real energy. The song is catchy both in theme and melody. But it's not only the tune that sets "Set Me Free" apart, it's the story it tells. Horton immerses us in his world with a story of desire, hope, and a longing for personal freedom. Simple but powerful, the lyrics convey the spirit of true liberation, breaking emotional, societal, or self-imposed chains. Horton sings with such conviction that his words weigh heavily. His narrative is straight-forward, brutally honest and relatable, a sort of catharsis anyone who has ever felt trapped or constrained can relate to. The song mixes soul, pop, and rock influences in a catchy but not overcooked hook. The instrumentation swells around Horton's voice, providing nuance and texture without overpowering the song's emotional heart. https://open.spotify.com/track/4YgMy9IXrWqMY8UHHCYNGv The rhythm section lays down the glue that holds things together, letting extra punchy bits here and there keep the fire burning and the ear engaged. "Set Me Free" is a song about freeing oneself, and Horton's delivery makes that message come to life in a way that's at once personal and communal. It's a devastating track for anyone who's ever wanted something more, for escape, for liberation. As it's the first single in a series, it promises plenty more musical gems to come. If this is the beginning, we can't wait to see where Horton's epic journey takes us next.
excerpt: Jack Horton delivers a soulful and empowering track, "Set Me Free," capturing themes of liberation and self-expression through heartfelt music.
